reading_declaration.method: Exact UTF-8 text deduplication for reading only; all distinct texts displayed in full in bounded terminal outputs, then each of the 275 slots reconnected to its actual question. Q001 displayed documents 1-5; subsequent outputs displayed distinct read IDs 6-24, 25-36, 37-64, 65-105, and 106-140. No displayed content was truncated.
reading_declaration.semantic_review: All 55 judgments were manually reasoned and authored individually. Code located selected quotations, calculated hashes, serialized judgments, and checked structure; it did not assign semantic labels.
reading_declaration.limits: Reading and semantic assessment are reviewer declarations. Programmatic byte/hash coverage verifies identity and mapping, not comprehension or independent approval.
